topic: A day on Venus is longer than its year
script: On Venus, a single day lasts longer than an entire year. Venus spins so slowly that one full turn takes about 243 Earth days. But it circles the Sun in only about 225 Earth days. And it spins backwards, so the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east. Even from one sunrise to the next takes about 117 Earth days, so a single afternoon would last for weeks. description:
Venus takes about 243 Earth days to spin once, but only about 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun, so a day there outlasts a year. It also spins backwards, so the Sun rises in the west. Even sunrise to sunrise takes about 117 Earth days.
